# Barrits Copilot Skills

This folder contains production-ready skills for two audiences.

## Maintainer Skills (this repository)
- `barrits-maintainer-full-cycle`
- `barrits-contribution-workflow`
- `barrits-incident-troubleshooting`
- `barrits-jsdoc-authoring`

## Consumer Skills (projects that use the package)
- `barrits-package-consumer-onboarding`

## Usage
- In Copilot Chat, invoke by intent or slash command when available.
- Skills are designed for deterministic, evidence-based execution.
- Keep commands and release evidence in the final report.
